gaps: P0: none (#1 is the 1697 Tre Kronor fire, misread as 1024; #2 is an undated later lithograph of 17th-century Stockholm).
notes: #4: Commons says about 1570 (drawing date); dated 1588 as B&H vol. 4. #12 (Dahlbergh, from the west) carries 1669, likely the drawing date, so the firmly dated #11 was used. #39/#40 (Thomas Fearnley, Stockholm from Klaravikstranden) are listed as 2018, the date of the museum photo; the painting is from Fearnley’s lifetime (1802–42) but no date is given, so skipped. Worth adding with a real date if one can be found: it would fill the 1830s. #23 is the ‘unprocessed’ LoC scan, colors a bit faded. #24–#29 are the 1897 exhibition (event views, not used). #31 (aerial before 1935) is an alternative for P5 but its date is loose.
